nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview for the novedades_mf microfrontend, describing its role in the Universidad Distrital contract-management single-spa architecture and giving setup steps for the Root, Core, and this microfrontend.

nodes.name: angular.json
nodes.summary: Angular CLI workspace configuration for the novedades-mf project, defining custom-webpack build/serve/test/lint targets and per-environment file replacements for single-spa packaging.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses @angular-builders/custom-webpack with a UMD library target so the app can be consumed as a single-spa microfrontend, plus per-configuration environment file replacements.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm manifest declaring Angular 18, Angular Material, TailwindCSS, single-spa/single-spa-angular dependencies and the build/serve/test/lint scripts for the microfrontend.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript build configuration for the application, extending the base tsconfig and pointing at src/main.single-spa.ts as the compilation entry file.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Base TypeScript compiler configuration for the workspace, enabling strict mode, strict Angular template/injection checks, and ES2022 module/target output.

nodes.name: tsconfig.spec.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for unit tests, extending the base tsconfig and including Jasmine types plus all *.spec.ts files for the Karma test runner.
